newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins 260 mln DM Belgian rail order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins 260 mln DM Belgian rail order.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Tuesday its transportation systems unit it would deliver 90 locomotives to Belgium in an order worth 260 million marks.

Siemens would manufacturer the diesel-hydraulic engines in Kiel with the particiaption of Belgian, the company said. It would deliver the first locomotives in 21 months to Belgium's state railroad company -- SNCB/NMBS.

In the six months to March 31, Siemens' transport systems unit saw sales fall 11 percent to 1.6 billion marks while orders rose 46 percent to 3.2 billion marks. In 1995/96, which ended September 30, the unit reported pretax profit of 19 million marks on sales of 4.3 billion marks.
